Class QueryBuilder

public inherited sharing class QueryBuilder

Fluent SOQL query builder that programmatically constructs and executes dynamic queries. Supports field selection, conditions (AND/OR), subqueries, ordering, and limits. Optionally validates SObject and field API names against the schema at build time via Tools.SObjectDescriptions.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:

Version:
    1.0

Constructors

private QueryBuilder(Boolean validateApiNames)

Main private constructor. Initializes all properties with default values.

Parameters:
    validateApiNames – If true, API names will be validated against the schema definition

public QueryBuilder(SObjectType sObjType)

Constructor that initializes the builder with an SObjectType. Validation is disabled.

Parameters:
    sObjType – The SObjectType to query from

public QueryBuilder(
  SObjectType sObjType,
  Boolean validateApiNames
)

Constructor that initializes the builder with an SObjectType and optional validation.

Parameters:
    sObjType – The SObjectType to query from
    validateApiNames – If true, API names will be validated against the schema definition

public QueryBuilder(String sObj)

Constructor that initializes the builder with an SObject API name. Validation is disabled.

Parameters:
    sObj – The SObject API name to query from

public QueryBuilder(
  String sObj,
  Boolean validateApiNames
)

Constructor that initializes the builder with an SObject API name and optional validation. Throws QueryBuilderException if validation is enabled and the SObject does not exist.

Parameters:
    sObj – The SObject API name to query from
    validateApiNames – If true, API names will be validated against the schema definition

public QueryBuilder addAndCondition(String cond)

Appends an AND condition to any existing condition. If no condition exists yet, sets it as the initial condition.

Parameters:
    cond – The condition expression to add (e.g., Name LIKE '%LLC')

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining

public QueryBuilder addCondition(String cond)

Adds a condition to the query using AND logic. Delegates to addAndCondition.

Parameters:
    cond – The condition expression to add

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining

public QueryBuilder addField(String fieldName)

Adds a single field to the SELECT clause.

Parameters:
    fieldName – The field API name to add

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining

public QueryBuilder addFields(List<String> fieldNames)

Adds multiple fields to the SELECT clause from a list of strings. When validation is enabled, throws QueryBuilderException for invalid field or relationship names.

Parameters:
    fieldNames – The list of field API names to add

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining

public QueryBuilder addFields(Set<String> fieldNames)

Adds multiple fields to the SELECT clause from a set of strings.

Parameters:
    fieldNames – The set of field API names to add

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining

public QueryBuilder addOrCondition(String cond)

Appends an OR condition to any existing condition. If no condition exists yet, sets it as the initial condition.

Parameters:
    cond – The condition expression to add (e.g., Name LIKE '%LLC')

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining

public QueryBuilder addSubQuery(QueryBuilder builder)

Adds a subquery by automatically resolving the child relationship name from the builder's SObject. Requires validation to be enabled. Throws QueryBuilderException if the relationship cannot be found.

Parameters:
    builder – The QueryBuilder instance to add as a subquery

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining

public QueryBuilder addSubQuery(
  String relationName,
  QueryBuilder builder
)

Adds a subquery using an explicit child relationship name. When validation is enabled, throws QueryBuilderException if the relationship does not exist.

Parameters:
    relationName – The API name of the child relationship
    builder – The QueryBuilder instance to add as a subquery

Returns:
    QueryBuilder: This instance for fluent chaining
